zen.text: Chandra Nalaar first meets Zendikar as a hostile place, remarking that the land seems to go out of its way to kill you.
She and Jace defeat Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin, where her ghostfire destabilizes the enchantments holding the Eldrazi.

Years later, as abbot of Keral Keep, she is bound by a promise to stay on Regatha, but she planeswalks to Sea Gate for one look, burns three Eldrazi, and sees Ulamog advancing, realizing this is what she helped unleash.
Mother Luti reveals the ban was a test and sends her off to save worlds, but at Sea Gate a winged demon frees Ulamog from the hedron prison and a second titan rises.

roe.text: Chandra Nalaar, tricked by Ramaz into stealing the Dragon Scroll, follows its map toward the Eye of Ugin, and her theft ends with the Sanctum of Stars destroyed by her attack.
Gideon turns her over to Kephalai's soldiers but later helps her escape, and Jace tracks her to Keral Keep and defeats her there.
In Anowon's camp she asks for guidance and he agrees once he learns she also seeks the Eye, but he later tries to kill her and Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.
At the Eye, Sarkhan attacks her as a dragon, and she and Jace defeat him with Ugin's invisible fire, which loosens the Eldrazi's bonds so they rise to feed again.

m12.text: Chandra Nalaar's trip to the Eye of Ugin begins when she steals a scroll from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai, and Jace is hired to recover it, which leads both planeswalkers to Zendikar.
In this set Jace, Chandra and Garruk return in new versions, while Gideon and Sorin replace Ajani and Liliana.

ori.text: Chandra Nalaar is the first of five planeswalkers whose emotional awakening, powerful enough to ignite a spark, is told in the Magic Origins storyline.

As a child on Kaladesh she scares off her parents with a huge blast of fire and runs to the mountains, and when her village is burned and she faces execution, her spark ignites and she planeswalks to Regatha for the first time.

On Regatha she trains with the fire monks, though Serenok scolds her for not joining their spell, and Gideon is sent to apprehend her after she steals the Dragon Scroll and destroys the Sanctum of Stars.

When Walbert offers her to the Purifying Fire, it spares her and she destroys his forces, and after Serenok dies the monks choose her as abbot, though Gideon and Jace soon come asking for her help against the Eldrazi and she answers that she has made a promise to stay.

ogw.text: Chandra Nalaar arrives at the Battle for Zendikar and frees Gideon, Jace and Nissa from Ob Nixilis, scaring the demon off Zendikar.
The four swear an oath to stand together on the cliffs of Tazeem, founding the Gatewatch.

Then Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph, and when the titans are locked, Chandra attacks and Nissa channels leyline mana to her, igniting the leylines and destroying both Ulamog and Kozilek, to Ugin's anger.

cn2.text: Chandra Nalaar is hungover in Jace's house when Liliana wakes her, and she soon storms out of a meeting, furious at Baan's description of the renegades, and sets Gideon's punching bag ablaze while raging that the Consulate killed Kaladesh's best inventors.

Wondering whether she belongs, she clumsily tells Nissa that she felt her calm mind behind Zendikar's anger, and when Nissa offers to teach her to meditate, a mortified Chandra flees until Liliana finds her hiding in an alley.

Back on Kaladesh for the first time since she left, she searches for a renegade inventor with Liliana, punches a Consulate soldier unconscious, and shows Liliana a mosaic of her father Kiran while blaming an officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
She refuses Liliana's lethal option when guards chase them, blocking the alley with a wall of fire, and at the end she gapes at a woman with hair like her own and speaks to her as her mother.

kld.text: Chandra Nalaar returns to Kaladesh, where she recognizes the rogue artificer Renegade Prime as her mother Pia, only to see Consulate soldiers drag Pia away, and Oviya Pashiri promises to help free her.
The trail leads to the hidden Dhund, but Baral, warned by Dovin Baan, traps Chandra, Nissa and Oviya in a sealed chamber, and Oviya is badly wounded protecting Chandra.
Ajani frees them from the trap, and Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch means having a family on any plane.

At the Inventors' Fair, Chandra leaps into the arena to save her mother, refusing to lose her again, and when the Gatewatch's illusions dissolve behind her, Tezzeret retreats and she runs into her mother's arms.

aer.text: Chandra Nalaar is driven by anger at the man who took her father from her, and Baral uses that anger, taunting her to lure her away from the Gatewatch so that the Consulate retakes the Aether Hub.
She then volunteers to use her fire as a detonator in the thopter, and she and Gideon destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge from inside it, though Tezzeret escapes with its core.
She says a tearful farewell to her mother and home, and chooses to join Cloudspire rather than the Aether Rangers, to the public's shock.

akh.text: Chandra Nalaar arrives on Amonkhet with the Gatewatch in the middle of a sandstorm, intending to learn Nicol Bolas's plans and stop him, and she melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group.
In the city, Gideon insists they keep their origins hidden despite her wish to open the people's eyes, and he restrains her when soldiers seize a woman shouting that the trials and gods are lies.
She objects when Gideon enters the Trials as Oketra's Champion, and she and Gideon free Samut from her sarcophagus.
When the demon Razaketh takes hold of Liliana, Chandra engulfs him in fire at her signal, and the Hours are set in motion.

hou.text: Chandra Nalaar faces Nicol Bolas on Amonkhet, and he mocks her fire as her only trick.
He crushes her in his claws and defeats the Gatewatch, and Chandra, badly wounded, planeswalks away.

dom.text: Chandra Nalaar arrives on Dominaria wounded with Gideon, Liliana and Nissa, asks where Jace is, and learns he has given up, but after Nissa walks away she announces that she will leave to become stronger and planeswalks off in a rush of fire.
She goes to Regatha, takes Jaya Ballard's goggles from the monastery relics, and is caught by Luti, telling her she needs more power to fight Nicol Bolas, then heads back to Dominaria.
In Argivia she fights off kobolds and blasts through their barricade, and later in Yavimaya she learns that Luti is Jaya, her mentor.
She uses Nissa's visualization to calm Multani, who regains awareness, and Jaya, seeing her potential, invites her aboard.

m21.text: Chandra Nalaar appears on this set's cards as a pyromancer planeswalker who jokes with Teferi.

vow.text: Chandra Nalaar travels with Teferi and Kaya to Innistrad, where Arlinn asks for help as the nights grow longer, and they join Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
In Thraben, Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire as Adeline's cathars charge the undead, and the group crosses into Markov manor, where Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key and Arlinn takes it.
At the Voldaren Estate Chandra recalls the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key, and later she and Teferi burn down the manor's great door to begin the assault.
When the balance is restored, Arlinn sees Chandra and Adeline together under a willow tree, talking and embracing.

mom.text: Chandra Nalaar hears that Phyrexia has corrupted the World Tree and taken Nissa, and when the others refuse to return to New Phyrexia she erupts in anger and leaves, saying she will not leave her friends behind.
Wrenn joins her, and with Seven they head for New Phyrexia, where Chandra meets the Mirran survivors and plans to have Wrenn bond with the Invasion Tree to guide it.

The plan is a trap, and Chandra realizes Norn knew of the resistance all along, as a Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn and pins Chandra to the tree. Nissa begs her to join them in her own voice, but Chandra refuses and drives her fiery fist into the branch, blowing the platform apart.
Elspeth heals Chandra, and Chandra pulls Wrenn's fire into herself so Wrenn can shape it.

mat.text: Chandra Nalaar helps Nissa melt and bury her Phyrexian carapace in Zhalfir, and says she will leave the next day to find Ajani, which hurts Nissa when Chandra cannot say clearly what kind of love she has for her.
She returns when a beast attacks, apologizes for her broken promise, and tells Nissa that her connections are changing her voice into something more powerful.
With Zhalfir's power channeled through her, Chandra heats the creature into steam and rain, and then she and Nissa kiss and step through the portal together, hoping to find Zendikar.

dft.text: Chandra Nalaar competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix, telling reporters that her only reason for racing is to put a smile on Nissa's face.
She joins Cloudspire rather than her mother's team, then abandons the race to jump onto a dinosaur and rescue Loot, and Pia frees Loot and Daretti.
They escape through an Omenpath and crash into an oasis on Amonkhet, where Chandra confides her fear of losing Nissa's second chance at a spark.
Jace takes control of the wrecked racers and attacks, and Chandra refuses to hand Loot over, but he knocks out Chandra, Pia and Sita before Nissa rescues them and Elspeth heals them.

sos.text: Chandra Nalaar has gathered the Shattered, former Oriq who refused to attack the school, and tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.

Ajani insists Jace was unmade, and when Chandra says Jace is manipulating archaics and prepares to blast the giant one, he tackles her, and they fight until she hurls her fire over their heads and burns it.
She asks Ajani to help her kill the archaic before Jace can use it, and he agrees, but in the tunnels she hesitates, and Jadzi warns that killing it would treat the symptom and not the disease.

Chandra agrees to work together while knowing it is a lie, then tries to attack the archaic, and Ajani sends her fireball wide and stands between them. They fight until Ajani covers her hand, and she gives up.

fra.text: Chandra Nalaar and Ajani tell Vraska that Jace is alive, and they go to Muraganda to recruit Garruk, who agrees to help in exchange for information about wards and containment.
The Theorist, Jace's coldest part, wipes Vraska's memory and then commands them to fight one another, disabling Chandra's decision-making, until Tam heals them.

Chandra rages at the Detective's plan, comparing it to Gideon's death, and she hugs him goodbye. She tells another Jace, the Warden, she is sorry she was not a better friend, and he vanishes into her mind.
Vraska stabs the Theorist, Jace's mind is reunited, and he dies peacefully after telling Chandra she was like family. Emrakul then consumes the collapsing Echoverse, and Chandra escapes to Vryn.
